status: starter manifest; not a verified product catalog
rules: Use genuine supplier/manufacturer images for the exact SKU being sold.
AI-generated imagery may be used for generic editorial/category banners, not to misrepresent an actual product.
Record source, license/permission, SKU match, alt text and review status before publishing.

image_specs.product_listing: 1:1 square, consistent crop, neutral background, optimized WebP/AVIF
image_specs.product_detail: 1:1 or 4:5 based on actual photography, no stretching
image_specs.homepage_hero: Use original Figma frame ratio and export at suitable 2x resolution
image_specs.category_visual: Consistent style, clear subject, optimized file size
image_specs.editorial: Use licensed/original lifestyle imagery; descriptive alt text
